name: B10-0159/2026 (Verts/ALE) – The arbitrary detention of President Mohamed Bazoum by the junta in Niger
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the arbitrary detention of President Mohamed Bazoum by the junta in Niger
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the release of Niger's ousted President Mohamed Bazoum, his wife and everyone else held without trial since the 2023 coup. It asks the military authorities to treat detainees lawfully, with access to lawyers, doctors, food and family, and to let human rights monitors visit them. It also calls for a return to constitutional rule and elections, and for humanitarian aid to keep reaching people in need. This is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- The military authorities in Niger are urged to free Bazoum and other detainees.
- Detainees should get lawyers, doctors, food and visits from monitors.
- The Parliament asks for elections and continued humanitarian aid; no law changes.
